question: How will my career go, and when is the best time for a job change?

drafts.summary: A kendra-trikona raja yoga formed by the Sun and Mercury together in the 10th from the lagna supports your career, authority and reputation [rule:yoga.kendra_trikona_raja]. Budhaditya yoga, formed by the Sun and Mercury conjoined in the 10th from the lagna, adds intellect, communication and reputation [rule:yoga.budhaditya]. The house, lord, karaka, varga and panchanga votes all favour career, though the 10th house from the lagna is the weakest house by bhava bala and its lord Saturn has a low shadbala ratio [vote:career.house] [vote:career.lord] [vote:career.karaka] [vote:career.varga] [vote:career.panchanga].

areas.name: career

claims.text: The Sun and Mercury conjoined in the 10th from the lagna form Budhaditya yoga, slightly reduced by an avastha modifier [rule:yoga.budhaditya] [text:Phaladeepika/Sastri-1937/18/1].

The Sun, ruler of the 4th, conjoined with Mercury, ruler of the 2nd and 5th, in the 10th from the lagna forms a kendra-trikona raja yoga [rule:yoga.kendra_trikona_raja] [text:BPHS/Santhanam-1984/34/11-12].

Mars forms Ruchaka yoga from the lagna, in the 7th, and from the Sun, in the 10th, though it is weakened by Saturn's aspect, its tara from the Moon and an unfavourable placement for Mars [rule:yoga.ruchaka] [text:BPHS/Santhanam-1984/75/1-2].

The house vote favours career: from the lagna the 10th house in Aquarius is the weakest at 4.51 rupas, but the 2nd, 6th and 11th are strong, and the 11th house is strong from the Moon at 8.51 rupas and from the Sun at 8.95 rupas [vote:career.house].

The lord vote favours career: the 10th lord Saturn sits in the lagna in a friend's sign with a shadbala ratio of 0.69, while the 6th lord Venus is exalted in the 11th, Mars owns and occupies the 7th, and the Moon, 10th lord from the Moon, has a shadbala ratio of 1.27 [vote:career.lord].

The karaka vote favours career: the Sun and Mercury occupy the 10th in Aquarius, Venus is exalted in Pisces in the 11th, and Saturn in the lagna in a friend's sign has a shadbala ratio of 0.69 [vote:career.karaka].

The varga vote favours career: in the D10 Mars in Capricorn scores highest, Saturn in Capricorn scores positively, the Sun, Jupiter and Venus score mildly positive, and the Moon and Mercury are neutral [vote:career.varga].

The panchanga vote favours career: Mars, which has a shadbala ratio of 1.3 and rules the tithi and nakshatra, rules the 7th from the lagna and the 10th from the Sun, and the Moon, ruler of the weekday, rules the 10th from the Moon [vote:career.panchanga].

areas.paragraph: Two combinations sit in your house of work, both formed by the Sun and Mercury together there: Budhaditya yoga, a Sun and Mercury combination, which favours intellect, communication and reputation, and a raja yoga, a combination of a ruler of an angle with a ruler of a trine, which favours authority, reputation and career [rule:yoga.budhaditya] [rule:yoga.kendra_trikona_raja]. Mars forms Ruchaka yoga, a Mars combination for drive and courage, though Saturn's aspect and an unfavourable placement for Mars weaken it [rule:yoga.ruchaka]. The house vote, the lord vote, the karaka vote, the varga vote and the panchanga vote, five separate ways of reading the chart, all lean towards career [vote:career.house] [vote:career.lord] [vote:career.karaka] [vote:career.varga] [vote:career.panchanga]. The house vote and the lord vote also show the soft spot: the house of work itself is the lowest in strength of the career houses, and its ruler Saturn falls short of the strength it needs [vote:career.house] [vote:career.lord].

areas.name: marriage

claims.text: The house vote favours marriage: from the lagna the 7th house in Scorpio is near average at 7.37 rupas while the 2nd and 8th are strong, and from the Sun the 7th house in Leo is strong at 8.51 rupas [vote:marriage.house].
The lord vote favours marriage: the 7th lord Mars occupies its own sign Scorpio in the 7th, and Venus, lord of the lagna, is exalted in the 11th with a shadbala ratio of 1.33 [vote:marriage.lord].
The karaka vote favours marriage: Venus is exalted in Pisces in the 11th, Jupiter sits in the lagna in an enemy's sign, and Mercury is in the 10th in a neutral sign [vote:marriage.karaka].
The varga vote favours marriage: in the D9 Saturn in Capricorn scores best, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter and Venus score mildly positive, and the Sun in Gemini is neutral [vote:marriage.varga].

The arudha vote leans against marriage: the upapada falls in Gemini in the 2nd, occupied by Rahu with no benefics, and the second upapada in the 3rd and the A7 in Leo in the 4th are empty [vote:marriage.arudha].

The KP vote favours marriage: the 7th cusp lies in Saturn's star with Mercury as its sub, and Mercury's star ruler Mars, occupying the 7th and owning the 7th and 12th, signifies the 7th with no denying signification, which decides the vote, while Mercury itself signifies both the 2nd and the 10th [vote:marriage.kp].

The panchanga vote favours marriage: Mars, which has a shadbala ratio of 1.3 and rules the tithi and nakshatra, rules the 7th from the lagna and the 7th and 2nd from the Moon [vote:marriage.panchanga].

areas.paragraph: The house vote, the lord vote, the karaka vote, the varga vote, the KP vote and the panchanga vote all lean towards marriage [vote:marriage.house] [vote:marriage.lord] [vote:marriage.karaka] [vote:marriage.varga] [vote:marriage.kp] [vote:marriage.panchanga]. The lord vote rests on Mars, ruler of the house of partnership, sitting in its own sign in that house, and on Venus, ruler of your ascendant, exalted, in the sign where it is strongest [vote:marriage.lord]. The arudha vote, a reading of the points that stand for a partnership in Jaimini's method, leans the other way: the first of them holds Rahu and no benefic planet [vote:marriage.arudha].

areas.name: longevity

claims.text: The house vote is favourable here: from the lagna the 8th house in Sagittarius is strong at 8.95 rupas and the lagna in Taurus is near average at 7.16, while from the Sun the 1st house in Aquarius is the weakest at 4.51 rupas [vote:longevity.house].

The lord vote is favourable here: the lagna lord Venus is exalted in the 11th, the 8th lord Jupiter sits in the lagna in an enemy's sign, and the 3rd lord Moon is in the 6th in a neutral sign [vote:longevity.lord].

The karaka vote is favourable here: Saturn and Jupiter both occupy the lagna in Taurus, Saturn in a friend's sign with a shadbala ratio of 0.69 and Jupiter in an enemy's sign, and Venus is exalted in the 11th [vote:longevity.karaka].

The varga vote is favourable here: the Moon is vargottama in Libra in the D9, Saturn scores positively in Taurus in the D30 and in Capricorn in the D9, while Jupiter in Virgo in the D30 scores negatively [vote:longevity.varga].
The arudha vote leans against here: Mars in the 7th and Saturn in the 1st each occupy an unfavourable placement for that planet [vote:longevity.arudha].

The panchanga vote is favourable here: Mars, which has a shadbala ratio of 1.3 and rules the tithi and nakshatra, rules the 3rd from the Sun, and the Moon, which has a shadbala ratio of 1.27 and rules the weekday, rules the 3rd from the lagna [vote:longevity.panchanga].

areas.paragraph: The house vote, the lord vote, the karaka vote, the varga vote and the panchanga vote all come out favourable here [vote:longevity.house] [vote:longevity.lord] [vote:longevity.karaka] [vote:longevity.varga] [vote:longevity.panchanga]. In the varga vote, the Moon is vargottama, in the same sign in the birth chart and in the ninth-part chart, while Jupiter scores against in the thirtieth-part chart [vote:longevity.varga]. The arudha vote leans against: Mars and Saturn each sit in marana karaka sthana, a placement the texts count as difficult for that planet [vote:longevity.arudha].
